<The letter addressed to
Michael reads as follows:

  M--I don't trust our
Johnson, and neither
should you!  His story
just doesn't wash and you
know it.  I'm out on this
one and I hope you are
too.  I'll wait for you
at the Tarislar City Inn
in Puyallup Barrens.

      Tabatha Shale >

Caleb Brightmore, a Mr.

from another unknown
Mr. Johnson, assembled
Michael's team to go
into the Salish-Shidhe.

Boris Errascoe was the

<Holopix>

 David William Owlfeather

  Salish-Shidhe Rangers
    Wilderness Patrol

Owlfeather is stationed
at the Ranger Outpost in
the AmerIndian Village.

A Visa is required for
entrance to the
Salish-Shidhe.

Owlfeather will name
someone who can help,
but only if his brother
is returned.

His brother's name is
Aragorn and he was last
reported in Seattle.

Aragorn, Owlfeather's
brother, was quite vocal
around town about taking
on a corporation for a
local "Johnson".

He has not been seen
since.

Aragon was caught by
Mitsuhama in a failed
Shadowrun.

He is being detained
inside the corporation.

You freed Aragorn from
Mitsuhama who then ran
off without any "thanks".

Ungrateful wretch!

Maybe Owlfeather will
give you the name of
his friend anyway.

Owlfeather tells you to
seek out Spirit Eyes.

He is a powerful shaman
at the Medicine Lodge on
Council Island.

Spirit Eyes needs three
spell components so he
can discern the true
identity of your enemy.
The first item is the\nhorn of a Gargoyle.
The second item is the\npelt of a Hellhound.
The third item is the\nliving scale of a\nFeathered Serpent.

Your enemy is an evil
being with the face of
a jackal.

His name is Thon.

He is the one who had
Michael killed.

Renraku began harassing
Boris after Michael had
visited him to purchase
equipment for his run.

Mako Sochou is heading
the Renraku inquiry.
Mako has been spending\na lot of his time at\nClub Penumbra lately.

Michael's run was a
reconnaissance mission
to seek out a cave deep
in the wilderness.

The run contract was
given to Caleb by an elf
named Frosty.

He says that she hangs
out in the Puyallup
Barrens.

Mako's orders were to
keep track of Michael's
progress.

After the team's demise,
a new project director
replaced Mako.

His name is Ito Ogami.

Ito Ogami is part of a
special projects team
that gets sent in to
clean up botched
missions.

Ito Ogami is staying at
the Gates Undersound
Hotel in Downtown
Seattle.
Ito Ogami is holding a\nmeeting at Matchstick\nin Downtown Seattle.

The Sinsearach Tribal
Elders will not answer
your questions until
you've proven your
trustworthiness.

Your current task is to
deliver a gift from
Lady Gillian to Red
Buffalo Woman in the
AmerIndian Village.
You have a return gift\nfrom Red Buffalo Woman\nfor Lady Gillian.

Your current task is to
find Ilene Two Fists
and see her safely
returned to the
Sinsearach.

Ilene is doing time in
Hollywood Correctional
for a botched run on
Ares.
You have completed your\nsecond task by freeing\nIlene from Hollywood.

You have vowed to aid,
defend, and respect the
Sinsearach for the rest
of your life.

You have refused to
aid, defend, and respect
the Sinsearach for the
rest of your life and are
now at an impasse with
the tribal elders.

Frosty is a member of
the Sinsearach elves.

The tribal lands of the
Sinsearach are south of
the AmerIndian Village.

Harlequin is Frosty's
employer.

He can be found in the
Puyallup Barrens at the
Talisar Garden Apts.

Thon is a powerful free-
spirit who must destroy
magical artifacts to
replenish his energies.

Harlequin thinks that
Ogami and Renraku may
have some information
you are lacking.

Harlequin suggests a run
against Renraku to 
search for information
they may have on your
brother or Thon.

You possess a map which
is meant to overlay a
second map.

Without the second map,
it doesn't do you much
good...yet!

You now possess both the
landmark map and its
overlay.

The completed map now
shows you what you're
looking for.

Thon is looking for
Ellisia's tomb.

He hopes to find many
potent magical items
to absorb energy from.

Seek out Vigore and Jarl
for answers concerning
Thon and your brother's
death.
Vigore and Jarl have a\nsecret base somewhere\nin the Rat's Nest.

Now that you know the
exact location of the
tomb, Harlequin has
arranged transportation
for you to get there.

He is waiting for you to
assemble and equip your
team of shadowrunners
to go and confront Thon.
Renraku suspects that\nVigore and Jarl are\nworking for Thon.

You have Ito's personal
passcode.

It is quite possible
that all his information
is still in those
datastores.

With Ito dead, maybe
a run against Renraku
will garner something.

Stark is dying in the
wilderness.

He needs medical help
in order to move him.

Stark's heart is
failing and a normal
transplant won't be
strong enough to power
his cybernetic body.

Fuchi has a prototype
cyber-heart that is
being kept in their
building awaiting
shipping orders.

You have the prototype
cyber-heart!

Now back to Seattle
General to see if it'll
help Stark.

Gunderson seemed curious
about Vigore's doings
in the Rat's Nest in
Redmond Barrens.

confirmed to be somewhere
in the Salish-Shidhe.

artifacts we can profit

be secured in the upper

billed to the hotel.

heart set for transport.

prototype cybernetic

the most secure.

To: All Concerned

Fr: Head of Security
       Mitsuhama

We had a break-in!!
Perp was a lone male
AmerIndian.

We have neutralized him
and are holding him for
questioning.

We will detain him until
he tells us what we want
to know.

Fr: Mitsuhama
      Interrogations

The prisoner has cracked
somewhat.  The arrogant
drek let his name slip.
He's called Aragorn.

I am transferring him to
the fifth floor, to
increase the pressure.

I will inform you when I
break him further.

by the name of Joshua.

in relation to various

Sir,
We have tracked down a
Feathered Serpent in

It is located in the far
east cave below the 
Sinsearach compound.

We have removed Mako 
Sachou as Project Leader

His failure in tracking
the subjects has been
noted.

His replacement is on his
way and will resume the
search ASAP.

Fr: Ito Ogami

Confirmed - Frosty after
Ellisia.

Have recovered the map,
and it's locked in my
safe in the Arcology.

All Project files have
been transferred to my 
personal system.

Fr: Ito Ogami

I have resumed a dialog
with Vigore.  Thon is 
anxious for the Project
to proceed.

I will stop at nothing
to complete this Project.

Last seen leaving the 
Tarislar City Inn.

She then headed for the
Sinsearach.  We lost
track of her soon after.

A meddler named Joshua
has become too involved
in our affairs lately.

Hunt him down and make
him understand we are
none of his concern.

An unknown force has
compromised the Project

This force is led by a
man with the street name
Joshua.

Find him and remove him
from our equation.

To: Strike Team Captains

Fr: Ito Ogami

Joshua has become too
involved in the Project.
The first Team to bring
me his head will receive
a 50,000$ bonus.

To: Mako Sachou

Frosty has unwittingly
given us assistance on
the Ellisia Project.

We have retrieved an
ancient parchement
which appears to be
a map of some kind.

The map has been moved
to the Renraku Arcology.

Sir,

our copy of the map to 
Ellisia's tomb has been
stolen, perhaps by Thon's
men.

With the map gone, and
both Sachou and Ogami
dead, we cannot hope to
find the Tomb.
